CloudBackup.title: CloudBackup
CloudBackup.description: Client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted MengiTex backup snapshot stored privately per authenticated Google user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this encrypted backup.

label.description: Human-readable backup name or description (1-100 chars).

deviceModel.description: Origin Android device model label (1-80 chars).

encryptedPayload.description: Base64-encoded client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted MengiTex archive payload.

messageCount.description: Number of SMS messages included in this snapshot.

templateCount.description: Number of message templates included in this snapshot.

contactCount.description: Number of saved contacts included in this snapshot.

passwordProtected.description: Whether the payload was encrypted with a user-provided PBKDF2 passphrase.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/cloud_backups/{backupId}.description: Per-user private encrypted MengiTex cloud backup snapshots isolated by Firebase Auth UID.
